description:
Pack your bags, kids—it’s time to tour some of America’s most important landmarks! In this Let's Tour National Monuments marathon, we’ll explore the Statue of Liberty, Mount Rushmore, the Liberty Bell, Arlington National Cemetery, the White House & Washington Monument, the Hoover Dam, California’s historic missions, Plymouth Rock, and the Pearl Harbor Memorial. Discover the history, stories, and heroes that shaped our nation in this fun and educational adventure!
